exposure: ultrasound guided bilateral transversus abdominis plane block (TAP block)
outcome: post-operative pain relief (Pain score, Visual Analogue Score)
time to first request for analgesic (time for asking for painkillers)
opioid related side effects (additional requirements of opiates-analgesics)
cohort: 200 mothers aged 20 to 50 years undergoing obstetric and gynecological surgeries were included.
finding: The Transversus Abdominis Plane block significantly reduced pain intensity, delayed the requirement for painkillers, and decreased additional requirements of opiates-analgesics compared to conventional analgesic techniques.
